solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reverse-bits/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

190. Reverse Bits

Reverse bits of a given 32 bits signed integer.

Example 1:

Input: n = 43261596
Output: 964176192
Explanation:

Integer           Binary
43261596          00000010100101000001111010011100
964176192         00111001011110000010100101000000

Example 2:

Input: n = 2147483644
Output: 1073741822
Explanation:

Integer           Binary
2147483644        01111111111111111111111111111100
1073741822        00111111111111111111111111111110

Constraints:

    0 <= n <= 2^31 - 2
    n is even.

Follow up: If this function is called many times, how would you optimize it?
"""


class Solution:
    def reverseBits(self, n: int) -> int:
        result = 0
        for _ in range(32):
            result = (result << 1) | (n & 1)
            n >>= 1
        return result


sol = Solution()

print(sol.reverseBits(43261596))  # 964176192

assert sol.reverseBits(43261596) == 964176192
assert sol.reverseBits(2147483644) == 1073741822

assert sol.reverseBits(0) == 0
assert sol.reverseBits(1) == 2147483648
assert sol.reverseBits(2) == 1073741824
assert sol.reverseBits(4294967294) == 2147483647
assert sol.reverseBits(2863311530) == 1431655765
assert sol.reverseBits(1431655764) == 715827882
assert sol.reverseBits(8) == 268435456
assert sol.reverseBits(16) == 134217728
assert sol.reverseBits(1024) == 2097152
assert sol.reverseBits(65534) == 2147418112
assert sol.reverseBits(1234567890) == 1262512530
assert sol.reverseBits(4000000000) == 1365623
